svg.aria-label: I'm a Data Engineer and Data Analyst focused on turning raw data into reliable data pipelines, meaningful insights, and practical Business Intelligence. My experience spans the data lifecycle. On the engineering side I work with Python, SQL, Apache Spark, Kafka, Airflow, Snowflake and Databricks. On the analytics and BI side I use Power BI, Tableau, DAX, Power Query, SQL and Python.
